what: On hover the vertical card turns half a revolution on the Y axis to show its back (intro text), and turns back when released — .55s smooth to open, .63s heavy to close. On touch devices it flips on tap

options.ease: Open/close curve — a CSS name (ease) or ”0.25,0.1,0.25,1”. To set them separately use ease-open · ease-close. Default open 0.215,0.61,0.355,1 · close 0.77,0,0.175,1
options.aria-disabled=\"true\": That element does not flip for a moment — only when opening the center card in a paging slider

from.where: index.html .hm-card (three researcher cards, on phones only the center card in the swiper)
index.html .ac-support__card (four oval support menu cards — original #top_support .inner transform 1s ease, green panel on the back)
